# stalwart_external_public_key (Data Source)

Public key of a remote recipient used by the encryption gateway, entered manually, kept up to date from a discovery method or learned from received mail.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifier of the object.

### Read-Only

- `authenticated_encryption` (Boolean) All mail clients holding the private key can read AES-GCM with RSA-OAEP. Applies to S/MIME RSA and elliptic-curve keys. Apple Mail and Thunderbird ESR cannot read it.
- `blocked_fingerprints` (Set of String) Fingerprints of keys that were revoked or rejected and are not accepted again
- `capabilities` (Set of String) Encryption features supported by the key
- `description` (String) Description of the key
- `email_address` (String) Address the key is used for
- `expires_at` (String) When the key stops being used: its own expiration date or, for keys from DNSSEC, the end of the DNS TTL
- `fingerprint` (String) Fingerprint of the key or certificate used for encryption
- `first_seen` (String) When the key was first stored
- `key` (String) OpenPGP key or S/MIME certificate, armored, PEM, or binary encoded as base64; an S/MIME certificate may be followed by its intermediate certificates
- `key_type` (String) Type of key and its encryption algorithms, taken from the key itself
- `kind` (String) Type of key, taken from the key itself
- `last_checked` (String) When the key was last confirmed by its discovery method or certificate check
- `last_seen` (String) When the key was last seen in a discovery result or received message
- `next_capabilities` (Set of String) Encryption features supported by the replacement key
- `next_check_at` (String) When the key is next fetched or checked
- `next_expires_at` (String) Expiration date of the replacement key
- `next_fingerprint` (String) Fingerprint of the replacement key
- `next_key` (String) Replacement key waiting for approval, or for the current key to expire
- `next_key_type` (String) Type of the replacement key and its encryption algorithms
- `pinned` (Boolean) Never replace this key automatically
- `smime_ciphers` (Set of String) Content encryption algorithms advertised by the recipient in signed S/MIME messages
- `smime_oaep` (Boolean) Whether the recipient advertised support for RSA-OAEP in signed S/MIME messages
- `smime_signed_at` (String) Signing time of the message the S/MIME capabilities were learned from
- `source` (Attributes) Where the key comes from; it cannot be changed once the key is created (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source))
- `status` (String) Whether the key is used
- `trust` (String) Trust level derived from the source and certificate validation

<a id="nestedatt--source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source`

Read-Only:

- `method` (String) Where the key is fetched from
- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.
